name: labs/drmcnelson__linear-ccd-with-ltspice-kicad-firmware-and-python-library
title: TCD1304 linear CCD (TCD1304Rev2Controller)
intro: TCD1304 linear CCD (TCD1304Rev2Controller), adapted from drmcnelson/linear-ccd-with-ltspice-kicad-firmware-and-python-library. It reads `identifier`, `configuration`, `pixel_count`, `dark_pixel_count` and 1 more; runs `measure_intensity` and `set_holdoff`. `measure_intensity`: measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
